In the realm of administration, leverage artificial intelligence to optimize management processes, improve decision-making efficiency, and enhance the overall educational experience. 

4. Question: What are the policy highlights of the "Action Plan"?
First, achieve comprehensive coverage of artificial intelligence education across all stages. In basic education, ensure that artificial intelligence courses are fully implemented, focusing on stimulating students' curiosity, cultivating innovative thinking, and enhancing their ability to solve complex problems. In higher education, promote artificial intelligence as a public foundational course, encourage interdisciplinary innovation in artificial intelligence, and optimize the adjustment of academic programs to meet the new demands for talent in the intelligent era. In vocational education, promote the intelligent transformation of traditional industry-related programs, cultivating high-skilled talents that adapt to industrial changes. In lifelong education, develop quality resources tailored to different groups, ensuring that all learners have equal opportunities to learn about artificial intelligence.

Second, promote the application of artificial intelligence across all scenarios. In student learning, develop intelligent learning companions to support comprehensive development in moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic, and labor education, with a focus on promoting ideological education online and personalized learning for students, thereby enhancing educational equity and inclusiveness. In teacher instruction, develop intelligent tools to support teaching effectiveness and foster professional growth for educators. In administration, utilize artificial intelligence to streamline management processes, improve decision-making efficiency, and enhance the overall educational experience.
